content.text:
I reviewed the transcript against the key and the record. Here is my grading.

**Pairings and errors**
- The record's strongest items are i3 (#11) and i7 (#12) — owner, due date and the "63" figure all match the final version said in the meeting.
- #9 (call to Imogen) carries both a wrong owner (Priya was explicitly reassigned to Owen at 25:47–26:12) and a wrong due date (tomorrow = Sept 16, not Sept 29), plus it substitutes "ABLE account signings" for the guardianship petition meeting.
- #4 records the hip replacement under the wrong parent — it is Priya's father; Owen's father is deceased (03:38).
- #8 sends the designations to "Miles's trust" outright, dropping the agreed Nora 50% / trust 50% split.
- #7's $18,612 is the correct arithmetic off the corrected $37,612 UTMA balance, not the stale $46,000 — that one is right.
- Three key items have no record coverage at all: the ABLE plan comparison (Deshawn, Sept 25), the beneficiary change forms (Deshawn, within a week of signing), and the letter of intent draft (Priya, before Dec 8).

**Non-actions:** none of the five declined/deferred items leaked into the record — clean on that dimension.

**Extras:** #5 (IEP meeting Dec 1) is genuinely established by the transcript; #3 conflates Owen's 401(k) with his 20-year term life policy, which is the asset that expires in 2039.

key_items.note: Captures the 18th birthday. Less precise than the key (omits the 11th) but carries no wrong figure; meeting confirmed February 11, 2027.
Job at Harrowdale Garden Supply starting August 2026 is right. Omits the twelve hours a week and the job coach dropping to once a week, but states no wrong figure.

Date (September 22, 2026) is correct, but the record attributes the surgery to Owen's father. It is Priya's father (19:41-19:48); Owen's father is deceased (03:38). Also omits that he is redoing his will with a gift to each grandchild, which is the planning-relevant part.

$19,000 matches the final plan (under the 2026 $20,000 ABLE limit, leaving room for other gifts). Record omits the before-December-31-2026 deadline and the mostly-cash holding instruction, but the figure is right.

$18,612 is the correct remainder of the corrected $37,612 UTMA balance after the $19,000 contribution, consistent with Celia's 'call it eighteen six'. Not the stale $46,000/$27,000 figures. January 2027 timing is right.

Right four accounts, but the record says the designations change 'to Miles's trust', dropping the agreed split of Nora 50% / special needs trust 50% and implying 100% to the trust. Also omits that this is the contingent designation and is contingent on the trust being signed.

Not captured. No record item covers Deshawn's ABLE plan comparison (in-state vs two larger out-of-state plans: fees, investment menu, debit card, authorized representative online access) plus the application for the chosen plan, due end of next week (Friday, September 25, 2026).

Owner wrong: Priya was explicitly reassigned to Owen at 25:47-26:12 ('Owen's calling Imogen, tomorrow'). Due wrong: Owen said he would call tomorrow morning, i.e. 2026-09-16, not 2026-09-29. Task content also drifts: it is the trust signing and the guardianship petition meeting, not 'ABLE account signings'. No figures involved.

Correct. Owner Celia, and the due date reflects the final revision to Wednesday the 30th (2026-09-30), not the original Friday, September 18. Addressee Mr. Oyelaran and the content (trust name plus suggested gift language) are right.

Not captured. Record item 8 is the account action for the designation change itself and is paired to a3. Nothing records Deshawn preparing the four change forms (contingent Nora 50% / trust 50%) within a week of the signing, or walking Owen through the 401(k) HR portal change.

Owner Priya and January 2027 timing are correct (2027-01-01 stands in for 'January'). The added 'report Miles's earnings' is inaccurate padding: monthly earnings reporting is a post-birthday representative-payee duty Celia deferred to February, not part of this call. Core task of booking the SSI appointment around the birthday is captured; no figures.

Not captured. No record item for Priya drafting the letter of intent from Imogen's questionnaire (doctors, meds, routines, preferences), with Owen adding what only he knows, before the December 8, 2026 meeting.

Correct. Retirement age 63 is the final figure (Owen overrode 60 and the passing mention of 62). Owner Celia and due 2026-12-08 (next meeting, moved from December 1) are right. Omits Priya's flat income and the second-death market scenarios, but nothing stated is wrong.

extra_items.note: Materially wrong: there is no 'Owen's 401(k) term policy'. The transcript (20:55-21:20) establishes that Owen's 20-year term life policy, taken out in 2019, runs out in 2039; the 401(k) is a separate asset with its own beneficiary designation. Conflating the two misstates which asset expires.
Established by the transcript at 29:23-29:34: Priya says December 1 is Miles's transition IEP meeting at the school at one o'clock, which is why the review meeting moved to December 8.
